title: bind support and recovery evidence to controlled canary and rollback outcomes

files.role: RC9 controlled execution support/recovery evidence binding script

criteria: The support/recovery evidence chain binds RC9 activation denial, rollback denial, rollback PlanSpec requirement, support metadata, recovery operations, compatibility metadata, and rollback baseline.
The support bundle projection is redacted, local-only, hash-bound, and upload-disabled.

Recovery references remain projection-only and non-executable until external object publication, drift reconciliation, installer fetch, canary enrollment, exact approval, AgentCore PlanSpec, SecurityExecutionEngine approval, activation execution, and remote fleet execution gates are complete.

The task preserves production_ready_claim=false and does not sign, upload payloads, install, activate, rollback, recover, mutate boot metadata, mutate active slots, mutate persistent state, mutate production rings, upload support bundles, dispatch remotely, or grant TUI authority.
